_approach: Complextro's studio-edit stutter turned into a build device: the hi-hat stutter-repeats from the complextro groove tighten and speed up bar over bar into a dense wall while the kick doubles from quarters to 8ths, both peaking at 127 together on the last 16th with no crash — the abrupt, edit-heavy build complextro-derived dariacore sections favour over a smooth cymbal swell. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
